text.content:
Jet skates, spray cans and pirate radio, from the rooftops down.

Turf: Kabuki and Little China, rooftops and walls; anywhere the Claws hang a lantern
Known for: Graffiti, pirate radio, courier runs, knock-off Tokyo streetwear
Leadership: Sora Ihara, granddaughter of the G3's Hazumi Ihara
Allies & rivals: Patron: the Mox. Enemies: the Tyger Claws, the Kimen-Gumi, the Red Lanterns, Night Corp's cleaning crews
Hangouts: Lizzie's back stairs (#6), the Kabuki Market rooftops (#5), wherever the Gun-Gal transmitter is this week

In 2045 the G3 were Kabuki's anime posergang, with sculpted faces, custom chrome, mono-katanas and a pirate station called 100.0 G3 Gun-Gal. Their leader, Hazumi Ihara, was more than half cyberpsycho. The second Purge Ordinance listed them; during the Purge-Riot, Gun-Gal broadcast the Kabuki sweeps live until MaxTac found the transmitter on the fourth night. Hazumi was never seen again.

Their kids carried on. During the 2067 riots, kids on skates ran messages between the Mox's crews and painted Lizzie Borden's face over every Claw lantern in Kabuki. Afterward they took the old name and added one, and Sora Ihara has run the G4 ever since.

The Look

Tokyo pop streetwear, loud and layered; big headphones; painted faces or bright anime-style visors; spray cans on the belt; and jet skates, inline skates with ducted fans in the heels, louder than they're fast and faster than anything the Kimen-Gumi can run in.

The Wall War

A G4 piece over a Claw lantern means that shop has stopped paying the Claws, or should. Susie Q calls the G4 "the little sisters": the Mox buy their paint and skates, and the G4 run messages for Lizzie's, warn the dollhouses when Claws are coming, and keep eyes on every roof in Kabuki. 100.4 G4 Gun-Gal is back on the air with J-pop, skate-punk and Mox warnings in a code the Kimen-Gumi haven't cracked. Its DJ, Mangaka, is an original G3 forty years older than anyone else in the crew, and he says Hazumi is still out there.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 08
